description: Measure the local yardstick on the tip. Base: E116 code. Two untimed arms through the benchmark trial code, each on seeds 3-102 in its own fresh process: (A) 32 px phase -0.25 epoch (2.5 instead of 2.75), (B) 32 px phase +0.25 epoch (3.0). Index everything by samples (LR warmup/decay, floor-hold, renorm cadence, Muon x1.25 phase factor). Keep the freeze at 85% of the new total samples and the final-EMA/lookahead window pinned to the last 8 steps. All shapes are already static and warmed. Compare each arm with the pooled ~198-trajectory E116 baseline. For the scored row, rerun the E116 tip unchanged, which adds another distinct gate sample (H4.9.1).
